format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this world, like "world". It matches the file name.

level.description: Which level this is, by its id, like "room-1".

x.description: Where the level's left edge is on the map, in tiles.

y.description: Where the level's top edge is on the map, in tiles.

at.description: Where the level's top left corner is on the map, in tiles. Levels that touch along a side, and are open there, join into one place.

levels.description: The levels on the map, each with where it sits. Levels left out are not on the map.
